control_metadata.title: Cryptography (Weak Hash)
control_metadata.summary: Cryptographic controls should avoid weak hash algorithms such as MD5 and SHA-1.

remediation.rationale: Bounded weak-hash replacements such as MD5 or SHA-1 to SHA-256 can be applied with minimal local edits.
